verdict.rationale: A probe confirms https://www.intel.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content describing Intel, and a separate llms-full.txt is even cited as a docs source elsewhere in the pack, showing an agent can indeed be pointed at this file for machine-readable context. Missing for 10: product-specific (Core Ultra 258V) llms.txt rather than corporate-wide, and no evidence of additional agent-oriented API docs (openapi.json probes all 404).
